## Description

Rx items: drug (from formulary), form/strength, dose builder (dose, unit, route, frequency, timing e.g. "with dinner", duration, quantity), instructions; source chip (Added by you, Chart reconciliation); safety chip (results of MDV-P2-016). Discontinue lines from reconciliation. Free-text medicine allowed with review flag.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Dose builder produces a structured sig and a human-readable instruction in the selected print language.
- [ ] **AC2.** Lines from reconciliation (stop) appear as discontinue lines automatically.
- [ ] **AC3.** Free-text medicines are flagged and excluded from interaction checks with a visible warning.
- [ ] **AC4.** Draft Rx autosaves; Rx is not authorised until MDV-P2-017.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
